notes: Budgeted joint coverage sampling: four poles share the seeded random held-out window order of L34/N4070-, with each pole using its own contribution-id seed for uniform per-window selection. The 0.30 threshold and first-64-token exclusion match graph.coverage.draw; each pole stops after at least 16 distinct strong windows instead of oversampling 48. The final batch can contain extra qualifying windows; its batch size is recorded in methods.sampling. No label-based sample selection.
